summary: Add Controller snapshot list/create/rename/revert/delete relay and the VM Snapshots tab, backed by Core catalog and snapshot-metadata peer updates.

guide.reason: Operators can manage stopped snapshots from the Controller VM Snapshots tab as well as the host-local API.

api.reason: Adds Controller GET/POST/PATCH snapshot routes that queue Core-owned snapshot-create/revert/delete/metadata commands, and documents the peer snapshot-metadata action.

roadmap.reason: Advances in-progress S2 Controller UI; Phase 5 status unchanged until running capture and acceptance close.

state.record: Pool master's pool-vms.json snapshot catalog and owner managed journals; Controller only queues requests and displays master-reported catalog rows from ManagedState.pool_vm_snapshots.
state.reason: A fresh Controller adopts catalog and outcomes from host inventory without local snapshot state.

verification.method: go test ./internal/controller ./internal/agent. Disposable lab: Controller list returned the retained point; PATCH snapshot-metadata succeeded. Raw lab receipts under .cache were wiped after the session; results remain in the snapshots guide and browser QA.
